title: Harry and the Rock Star
plot_source_plaintext:
Fans and reporters disrupt court proceedings when Harry dates a rock star (Kristine DeBell), and tries to cope with a new court clerk.

Note: This is the first episode to have the evil laugh as part of the Starry Night Productions logo.
